turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our kitten is about to graduate to a proper litter tray and I can't pick a litter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The clumping clay one is cheap and easy to scoop, but it's dusty and gets tracked everywhere.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pine pellets smell nice and are biodegradable, though some cats hate the feel under their paws.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And silica crystals soak up smells really well, but they're expensive and crunchy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd start her on a low dust clumping litter, it's the closest to what most cats like naturally. If you want to switch to pine later, mix it in slowly over a couple of weeks.
